reviews.text: Nice staff. Good location

My dog literally pulls me here on our walks. Great selection, they sell his favourite chews and supplements. Sangita the owner is lovely, very helpful, and patient while my dog screams at her for treats. Highly recommend.

What a cool little store! They have a great selection of premium treats and dog toys. The owner was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and clearly cares about the community, from celebrating dog birthdays to supporting other local Canadian businesses. We love to see local businesses supporting each other, especially these days. I’ll definitely be coming back!
Sangita is super sweet and she has exceptional taste. Wonderful human. The pet store is smack in Kitsilano and she carries quality treats! Will always go back..
They have local single ingredients treats and toys! They care about the community! Great quality products and service!

Highly recommend stopping by Benni and Co on West 4th! It’s the cutest little boutique pet store, and the owner, Sangita, is wonderful, warm and welcoming! (As are the rest of the staff)

She is extremely supportive of local, independent Canadian (mostly women-owned) businesses, and I feel so lucky to have her support for my small local dog walking business too!

Thank you, Sangita, for your kindness and  generosity over the past year, for building a wonderful community, and for trusting me with your precious fur-baby, Charli! 💖🐾

Brought our new 10-week-old puppy in for our first visit, and Vicky was an absolute saving grace. She was kind, knowledgeable, and gave us great tips and product suggestions, genuinely one of the most helpful pet store employees I've come across and could tell she is passionate about the job. I asked if she owned the place, and she said no, which says a lot about the level of care she brings as staff.

A few things kept this from five stars: prices run a bit higher than other pet stores nearby, parking was a challenge, and the layout is cramped. It’s tough to navigate with a stroller, mobility aid, or more than one dog. The flooring is also quite slippery, which could be tricky for senior dogs.

Ask for Vicky if you can, she made the visit!

Absolutely the best pet store in Vancouver. Great selection and had everything my pup loves. The owner Sangita and her manager Charli are very welcoming. Their passion for pets makes this the ultimate destination for all dogs and cats

Wanted to check out this pet store today 2026-07-10 since I have two dogs and a cat, and would have been so convenient to have a pet store nearby.
I won’t be returning, but the store is cute, I guess. The selection is limited and prices are higher than the stores just two blocks away for the same products. I was excited to find a cute store nearby, but it’s a pass. The associate seemed just as unsure about their own products as I was.
I also checked online to see if they had more selection there. Instead, I found the owner(?)  on Instagram, where she throws around phrases like “I’m a little ADHD.” As someone who went through a lengthy diagnosis and medication trials, I found this pretty invalidating.
I’m sure she didn’t intend harm, but when people without diagnosed ADHD use it as casual shorthand, it dismisses the experiences of those of us who actually live with it, and makes it harder to be taken seriously when we do disclose it. Same for those who say “I’m so OCD”. I’d encourage her to learn more about what ADHD actually involves, and avoid using it colloquially without diagnosis.
Another thing I saw online, filming videos while driving? Not a great look, putting your dog and the community in danger. All in all I was left beyond disappointed by the store and the owner (?) who runs the social media page.
Great.
Locally owned business with lots of natural/organic options! Very lovely owner!

I’ve never written reviews, however I’m really disappointed after trying to visit this store. I came last week from out of town after seeing their Instagram. When I arrived, the store was closed despite being listed as open on google. I also checked their Instagram and did not see any posts or stories about their unannounced closure. I am giving the store two stars because from what I could see from the outside, it looks nice. But I will not take time out of my day again to drive there to visit knowing that they do not let customers know if they are not open. I understand they are a small business, but it’s basic decency to let your customers know if you won’t be open as expected- at least announce it on Instagram, it takes two seconds. They have lost a potential customer from me.
The cutest accessories for my dog and my sister's dogs! My go to spot for getting a gift for anyone who has a pet! & love that is is women-owned!

Benni & Co Pet Store is such a beautiful little gem 🤍 You can feel the love and care the moment you walk in – the owner is incredibly kind, attentive, and truly passionate about pets, always taking the time to help and give advice. Everything is curated with so much detail and heart, and it’s clear that both pets and their humans come first. A must-visit place if you're a dog owner visiting Kits✨

I found Benni & Co on Instagram and I was immediately impressed with the products carried. The owner Sangita is absolutely amazing with answering any questions.
I have now placed 2 online orders with Benni & Co for my pup and I couldn’t be more happy! I live in Ontario, and I have to say that this is my absolute favourite pet store and I will continue to order from this store. All of the products are of excellent quality. I definitely recommend stopping in if you are local or visiting Vancouver, and if not- place an online order, you will not be disappointed!!

My dog and I love Benni and Co and we have to stop in everytime we head to the dog beach for a little visit. We love this store for many reasons including the cutest toys and puppy outfits, the intentionality behind everything that is available for purchase, and lastly, because Sangita is just the most special human. She always makes my dog and I feel recognized and important to her. Also Charli is the hardest little worker and makes my day every time I see him.
Lovely experience, really amazing to find a store full of local products. Thank you!

This pet store is one of a kind, carrying only top quality products and offering great service. The owner was very friendly, helpful and knowledgeable when it came to choosing the right food and products for my puppy. We will be back! Thank you !

Came for the first time ever randomly on their Black Friday deal day and had one of the best customer service experiences I’ve had in such a long time. Couldn’t have been more helpful, I’ll definitely be back!

Benni & Co is honestly one of my favourite pet stores. They always have the best toy selection, and the treat wall is crazy in the best way. The store is beautiful, and the staff are always so friendly and helpful. Just such an easy, feel-good place to shop for your pup :) highly recommend!
Beautiful store and the owner was so nice, friendly and helpful.
benni and co always has baxter covered for all of his food and gear needs. the owner is friendly and willing to accommodate any of his special requests. we will keep going back!!

Fantastic customer service.  We used to shop at the big brands (Tysol, Korna, etc) but we now go to Benni & Co. for the location convenience and how helpful Sangita (owner) is to the needs of our dog.  Best pet shop in Kits!

My cats are clearly BIGGGGG fans of Benni & Co.! The moment I open a bag of treats, they come running and can’t get enough. Both have sensitive stomachs, so I’m always cautious about what I feed them but with the natural, high-quality ingredients Benni uses, we’ve never had a single issue. It’s such a relief to find treats that are both gentle on their tummies and absolutely irresistible to them. Benni & Co. has quickly become our go-to for anything cat-related, and I can confidently say it’s the best place for both cats and dogs! 💞💕

The very definition of a neighbourhood pet store. Their love for animals is obvious. They get to know you and your dog, remember their allergies and preferences and go above and beyond in every aspect of service.

Bought the full package for our puppy, she wore it once and it was too big, the owner refused to refund us because of a small scratch on it. Please go to some other pet store that actually supports pet owners. As well we are finding a lot of her stuff on marketplace
Coolest pet store in the city! Owner is awesome!

Thank you so much for opening your store early on Saturday and saving me (and my very punctual dog Miles) from a truly catastrophic morning. You didn’t just sell me poop bags—you rescued my dignity, my shoes, and probably several innocent bystanders.

Without your help, I would’ve had to MacGyver a solution using a grocery bag, some napkins, and an empty coffee cup. No one wants that. Especially my dog, who stared at me with judgment until you flicked the store lights on like a beacon of hope.

You are a true hero. Not all heroes wear capes—some wear red dresses and have excellent stock of pet hygiene products.

Forever grateful (and now well-stocked),
Arin

Wonderful and much-needed addition to the neighbourhood! Been meaning to review for a while, but just as well I waited as each subsequent visit has deepened my appreciation. Fab selection of toys, food, and treats curated by the lovely owner who puts her heart and soul into the business. Love her collab with new neighbour Cowdog - treats for everyone! Happy to support local!

Thank you for the 5 star review!

-Sangita

My mini dachshund and I love Benni and Co! Such a great selection of cute toys and quality treats from all of the specialty brands I would usually have to order online to get. Sangita, the owner, has poured so much warmth and love into this store - and it shows! I especially appreciate the dedication to stocking and highlighting local, female owned businesses. Definitely stop by and get a Bennicino for your pup, so delicious and cute!!

Highly Recommend This Store!
After visiting multiple pet stores across the city, I can confidently say this one stands out by far. From the moment you walk in, you can tell this place is run with love.
Sangita, the owner, is incredibly engaged, kind, and genuinely passionate about what she does. She takes the time to get to know her customers (and their pets!), and it really shows in the way she runs the store. Her warmth and care create such a welcoming, personal experience.
Whether you're looking for the perfect toy for your dog or some amazing local, healthy treats—you can’t go wrong here! The selection is thoughtful, high-quality, and just cute! 😍

We were so excited when Benni & Co opened nearby – our dog Ralph instantly fell in love with the food, treats, and of course, seeing Sangita at every visit! We really appreciate how she highlights female-owned brands and puts so much care into building genuine relationships with her customers. It’s always a great experience, and we've recommended Benni & Co to our friends and family. Sangita also goes above and beyond by welcoming special requests for specific food and treats, which makes it a convenient one-stop shop for us.

A must visit when you’re in KITS! Cutest dog store with lots of goodies and local /Canadian products. One of our go to dog places in YVR.

Also try the Bennicino!!
Cute shop with a great selection of toys, food, and treats! Worth a visit :)
so many unique treats for cats and dogs, everything feels so special and warm. my cat loved her strawberry matcha treat 🥰🩷 …

Benni & Co is such a lovely local pet store! The owner Sangita is so welcoming and her values are truly inspiring! She’s all about supporting local as well as women in business! Thanks for the great experience!

I never write reviews but I need to give this store and the staff a shout out. I met the store dog Bones and his mom, both were lovely and so helpful in choosing the right products for a gift for my friend’s dog. The cuddles I got from Bones made my weekend. I will definitely send other pet parents here!

Our Dog Ziggys favourite store in Vancouver , according to Ziggy they have the best treats . Staff is awesome and friendly , if they don’t have what your dog wants they order it and add it to their products . And always the best products , everything from food to treats to toys, clothes and all other stuff is always the best .

Go there , your puppy will not be disappointed !
Really cool pet store in Kits 🐾 Great selection of toys, accessories and treats! I even bought a matching outfit set for my dog and I, were obsessed 🙌 …
This is a super chic, adorable pet store. They stock many Canadian brands even local treats and toys. Female owned and operated. This is my go to pet store for my miniature dachshund.

Beautifully curated pet shop with a great selection of aesthetic and local products.
Home to some of my favourite brands!

The owner, Sangita, was also very sweet.
I met her in person after watching her shops Instagram reels (@benni.and.co) and she was just as lovely in person as she was on her socials.

10/10 recommend Benni & Co if you’re in the Kitsalino area or looking for a pet shop with tons of local brands!

Sangita’s shop is an absolute gem in our community. She is incredibly kind and always takes the time to remember the people (and pups!) who come through her door. It’s clear she genuinely cares—not just about animals, but about her customers too.

What really sets this store apart is Sangita’s commitment to quality and locality. She thoughtfully sources many products that are Canadian and locally made, which is so appreciated. The care she puts into curating her store is reflected in everything—from the healthy treats and durable toys to the welcoming atmosphere.

If you're looking for a place where you and your dog will be truly valued, this is it. I can't recommend it enough.
The store is super cute and holds tons of local/Canadian quality brands! The owner is really sweet and takes great care of her community as well
A welcome addition to west fourth. Such  a hard working entrepreneur that is very conscientious and attentive to her clients. This is a beautiful store with high quality pet products.

My pup and I love Benni & Co! I only buy Canadian dog treats, and they have the best selection.
My dog can be nervous in pet stores, but the spaciousness of Benni & Co. makes her relaxed enough to have a good shopping experience.
We also love the toy selection, and the excellent recommendations from Sangita.

My pups and I love Benni & Co! Definitely some of the BEST customer service at any pet store we’ve ever been to (and we’ve visited many)! We’re able to find super fun and unique products here that larger chain pet stores don’t carry. Overall a super fun experience for both me and my dogs visiting here!
LOVE Benni and Co. They have such a wide variety of food and treats and super cute dog toys.
Pest pet shop in Vancouver for sure. Will definitely be back 🙏 …

My goldendoodle Linus and I absolutely love shopping at Benni and Co! It’s such a welcoming space with an amazing selection of high-quality, locally sourced products. Whether we’re browsing for treats, toys, or something stylish, we always find something special. The staff is incredibly friendly and knowledgeable — you can tell they genuinely care about pets. Linus gets so excited every time we visit, and I love supporting a store that highlights so many wonderful local brands. Highly recommend to any pet lover!
Thank you for the 5 Star Review!
Our favourite pet store !!
Great selection of food and toys for your dog with great service! Zero complaints!

The owner of this pet boutique is truly one of the sweetest and kindest people we've ever worked with. She has such a special heart for supporting family-owned and women-owned businesses, and her genuine love for pets shines through in everything she does. We’re so grateful to have our handcrafted, sustainable toys in this adorable boutique. Don’t miss their special large rope ball—it’s a standout! Go check them out—you’ll feel the love the moment you walk in. 🐾💗

What a fabulous pet store for both the fur babies and the fur parents! I loved the incredible variety of high quality toys, chews and treats. The owner Sangita is really friendly and knowledgeable and you can tell she puts a lot of time and effort into researching the products in her store to ensure the most high quality experience for her customers. I highly recommend you bring in your fur babies to check out this great pet store in the heart of Kitsilano! We had a great time here today and my pups can't wait to come back!
Excellent choices and service

Gita carries the best products. I have purchased super healthy treats, best toys that my dog loves [and they last!], a waterproof harness and leash, a bed for him ... he loves everything from Benni & Co. !
Thanks for the 5 star review!
My dog loves this store and the owner is so friendly and kind. Everytime I take my dog on a walk he wants to come here.
Great new dog store on 4th, the owner is so lovely and knowledgeable able all of the brands she carries. Would definitely recommend!

This pet boutique on West 4th in Kitsilano is an absolute gem! Sangita, the owner, is so warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind—she makes every visit a pleasure. The product selection is always beautiful, thoughtfully curated, and a joy to browse. I especially love that so many of the products come from smaller or local brands, making it easy to support quality, ethical businesses. My dog absolutely loves everything from here, especially the treats! Whether you're looking for everyday essentials or something unique, this store never disappoints. Highly recommend for any pet owner! Definitely worth a visit if you find yourself in the area.

Benni & Co has the CUTEST stuff! It's my new favourite go-to pet store. The owner curates the best items - from toys, clothing, treats, food, etc. Very good quality and extremely cute. The only thing is that it's so close to my house and I want to buy everything in there - very dangerous lol
My pomeranian Kevin loves coming here!
Thanks for the 5 star review!
Thanks for the 5 star review!

Purchased a beautiful dog bed from this new pet boutique! I love how the owner makes an effort to source items from female owned and local companies. Definitely support this business.
We will be back soon 🐾 💕!!! …
Absolutely love our new Dino toy! Instant new favourite. Love the color and especially the material. Hershey is a chewer but this toy is tough! Loved checking out the new store!
